name: grill-me
description: Deep-extraction interview for the Strategy and Research Team (Atlas). Relentlessly interviews the user one question at a time until everything in their head about a process, offer, decision, or whole business is captured as reusable context — then persists it via session-capture. Use for /atlas-grill, "grill me", "grill me about X", "interview me on", "extract everything about", "I want to brain-dump", "understand my whole {business/process/offer}".
